_doc: Scenarios for zud_reference.rb (see its header). p/o: party specs (sp species, lv, m moves, it item, ab ability, hp fraction, st status, form, gmax G-Max Factor, dlvl Dynamax level); turns: one action per battler per round: 'N' move N, 'N>T' at battler T, 'Nd'/'Nz'/'Nu' with Dynamax/Z-Move/Ultra Burst toggled, 'sN' switch to party N, 'ai' the battle AI. trainer: the foe is a trainer (trainerType, trainerItems); battlescene: $PokemonSystem.battlescene (0 = animations on); double; bag: the player's key items (Dynamax Band and Z-Ring by default).
